title: Plactic monoid：证明或反驳所有 3-packed words 都 3-stable
summary: Every 3-packed word u is proved 3-stable for centralizer witnesses over all positive integers, including the empty word: C(u^k)=C(u^3) for every k>=3. G01-G06 are closed. The independent full proof-DAG referee returned fatal=0 and major=0 and issued a hash-bound post-repair PASS. Second novelty, citation, clean LaTeX, pagewise PDF, source-ZIP, and release-manifest gates passed.
